newsitem.title: UK: Versalite sets debut premium in heavy trade.
newsitem.headline: Versalite sets debut premium in heavy trade.

text.p: Shares in decorated glass maker Versalite Group Plc on Wednesday rose to a 42 percent premium in active trade on their first day of dealings on the London Stock Exchange(LSE).
The shares, issued at 3p, advanced 3/4p to 3-3/4 by 0945 GMT in volume of 12.4 million shares.
One dealer said he had executed some large trades that had yet to be published by the LSE.
"The issue was well received when the prospectus came out and now we are seeing interest as dealings have started," another trader said.
Versalite described the recent development of a machine which will enable coloured decorated flat glass to be mass produced for the first time as a "major breakthrough" for the company.
